AbcdeWidget.description:
Airway, Breathing, Circulation, Disability, Exposure: each checked from the monitor's own
data and prompts, then the most recent blood gas and bloods with when they were taken.
AbcdeWidget.title: AbcdeWidget

enabled.description: Master switch for everything AI draws: chips, certainty, trace annotations, explain links. A screen can override it locally (the AI On/Off button).
enabled.title: Enabled

show_resolved.description: e.g. 'Last run of AF 2 h 14 min ago'.
show_resolved.title: Show Resolved

show_trace_annotations.description: Brackets and flags on traces saying what the AI saw there and why.
show_trace_annotations.title: Show Trace Annotations

AiOverlayAction.description:
Turns the AI overview on or off for this screen: boxes on the traces, one or two words
each, over what the AI used (no P wave, irregular R-R). A local preference of the screen.
AiOverlayAction.title: AiOverlayAction

AiToggleAction.description:
Turns every AI mark on this screen on or off (interpretation chips, certainty, trace
annotations). A local preference of the screen; it does not create a design version.
AiToggleAction.title: AiToggleAction

AlarmDefault.description: Design-level default limits. Per-patient overrides are patient data.
AlarmDefault.title: AlarmDefault

Button.description: A button in the tab bar or the top bar. Where it sits is the designer's choice.
Button.title: Button

CertaintyDisplay.description: Which certainty metric drives the display, and how it is shown.
CertaintyDisplay.title: CertaintyDisplay

EditLayoutAction.description:
Enters Edit Layout: tap a module to change its size, content and place. Edits stay local
to this screen until they are saved as a new design version.
EditLayoutAction.title: EditLayoutAction

ForecastPanelWidget.description:
The Prediction view: future NEWS and the future observations, with their certainty. Each of the three
can be switched on or off on the screen; these are what it starts with.

show_certainty.description: Start with the certainty of each prediction shown.
show_certainty.title: Show Certainty

show_news_number.description: Start with the future NEWS shown.
show_news_number.title: Show News Number

show_observations.description: Start with the future observation predictions shown.
show_observations.title: Show Observations

ForecastPanelWidget.title: ForecastPanelWidget

GridItem.description: One module in the monitor grid: a row and the size it is drawn at.
GridItem.title: GridItem

LabelDisplay.description: How names are written on screen.
LabelDisplay.title: LabelDisplay

MeasureAction.description:
Starts a blood pressure or temperature measurement on one touch and cancels it on the next. There
is no menu or sheet: the module for that measurement pulses until the reading is in. (In this
prototype the reading is simulated.)
MeasureAction.title: MeasureAction

ModuleContent.description:
What a module shows besides its number. Each is dropped, lowest priority first,
if the module's size has no room for it (see registry.MODULE_SIZES).

ai.description: AI interpretation of this item. Off here turns it off for this module only.
ai.title: Ai

explain.description: A short 'why' line, with a tap for the full reasons.
explain.title: Explain

forecast.description: The dashed expected trend and what is expected next.
forecast.title: Forecast

readings.description: The last five readings of an intermittent measurement (blood pressure) with time, date and MAP.
readings.title: Readings

trace.description: The trace or trend (a small spark at small sizes).
trace.title: Trace

ModuleContent.title: ModuleContent

MonitorGridWidget.description:
The monitor: modules of different sizes packed into a grid of equal cells that
fills the pane. Order is reading order; each module goes in the first gap it fits.
A pane of full-width 'row' modules is the familiar bedside monitor.

columns.description: Grid columns. Cells share the pane equally.
columns.title: Columns

numerics_side.description: Which side the tile sits on in row-shaped modules.
numerics_side.title: Numerics Side

MonitorGridWidget.title: MonitorGridWidget

column_source.description: 'charted' = recorded observation sets; 'continuous' = derived from the wearable every interval.
column_source.title: Column Source

NotificationsDisplay.description:
The notification ticker: the one place alarms and monitoring problems are listed.

It is always on screen and always the same size. It says 'No Notifications' or
rolls through the current items, most serious first. A high-priority patient alarm
stops the ticker and is held on screen until it clears. Touching the ticker opens
the full list; the list never opens by itself. Nothing that arrives may move or
resize the rest of the monitor.

flash.description: Flash at the item's priority rate.
flash.title: Flash

NotificationsDisplay.title: NotificationsDisplay

PredictionOverlayAction.description:
Switches the main screen between the monitor and the prediction overlay: the monitor on the left half, the
trends with their predicted future and intervals on the right. A local preference of the screen.
PredictionOverlayAction.title: PredictionOverlayAction

PredictionTrendsWidget.description:
The trends with their predicted future and prediction intervals, on one time axis, with the future NEWS
over time. Used on the right of the prediction overlay of the main screen.

ahead_hours.description: How far ahead the prediction runs, right of now.
ahead_hours.title: Ahead Hours

back_hours.description: How far back the history runs, left of now.
back_hours.title: Back Hours

show_certainty.description: Start with the certainty of each prediction shown.
show_certainty.title: Show Certainty

show_news_number.description: Start with the future NEWS shown.
show_news_number.title: Show News Number

show_observations.description: Start with the observation predictions shown.
show_observations.title: Show Observations

PredictionTrendsWidget.title: PredictionTrendsWidget

Row.description:
One monitored item: what it measures, how it is drawn, and what it shows.
A row becomes a module when the monitor grid places it with a size.

height_scale.description: How tall this row is against the others in its line of the grid (1 = standard).
height_scale.title: Height Scale

method.description: How it is measured, shown after the label as 'Heart Rate - ECG'. Overrides the default (the row's waveform, else the registry method).
method.title: Method

numerics.description: Numbers shown at the right of the row, largest first.
numerics.title: Numerics

Row.title: Row

SafetyDisplay.description:
How monitoring problems are shown. See docs/human-factors.md.

Only presentation is adjustable here. That each state is shown, and shown
differently from every other state, is fixed: there is no option to hide the
alarm-paused state, a technical alarm, a battery warning or a lost signal.
SafetyDisplay.title: SafetyDisplay

SettingsAction.description: Opens the menu whose id is 'settings' (which must exist).
SettingsAction.title: SettingsAction

SheetAction.description: Opens a built-in panel over the current screen.
SheetAction.title: SheetAction

SilenceAction.description: Silences alarm audio for registry.ALARM_SILENCE_SECONDS (2 minutes).
SilenceAction.title: SilenceAction

SplitNode.description: Two panes side by side ('horizontal') or stacked ('vertical').

ratio.description: Share taken by the first pane.
ratio.title: Ratio

SplitNode.title: SplitNode

Sweep.description: How waveforms are drawn. The 'sweep break' is the moving erase gap.
Sweep.title: Sweep

mode.description: Which side of the dark / light switch this theme is.
mode.title: Mode

parameter_colours.description: Trace and numeric colour per parameter.
parameter_colours.title: Parameter Colours

forecast.description: Dashed forecast lines and bands. Keep distinct from the NEWS score colours.
forecast.title: Forecast

inactive.description: STANDBY and SEARCHING text: nothing is being measured.
inactive.title: Inactive

silenced.description: The alarm-sound-paused state: the silence button and its banner. Conventionally yellow.
silenced.title: Silenced

technical.description: Technical alarms and signal problems (connection, battery, sensor, poor trace). Must differ from the patient alarm colours.
technical.title: Technical

ThemeToggleAction.description:
Switches this screen between the design's dark and light themes. A local
preference of the screen (day / night); it does not create a design version.
ThemeToggleAction.title: ThemeToggleAction

TileDisplay.description:
The box holding a module's numbers. There is one tile per module, holding all of
its values (SpO2 and PR share one). In a full-width row the tile is this wide;
smaller modules let their tile fill the module. A tile never changes size whatever
it shows: numbers, STANDBY, CONNECTION LOST and a low-battery warning all fit.
TileDisplay.title: TileDisplay

buttons.description: Buttons at the right of the top bar, left to right (for example new patient, discharge, dark / light, settings).
buttons.title: Buttons

fields.description: Left to right. Must include 'name' and 'clock'.
fields.title: Fields

TraceDisplay.description: Reference marks drawn on every trace so it can be read, not just watched.
TraceDisplay.title: TraceDisplay

alt_theme.description: The other side of the dark / light switch.
